domain_focus: EventStoryLine atomic event mentions plus forward narrative PLOT_LINK learning; OWL-Time remains the external seed ontology.
abstraction_level: exact event mentions with sentence/token identity; shallow ontology-canonical event relations
population_policy: Keep the validated atomic event inventory and deterministic unordered pair pool. Classify only the earlier-mentioned event toward the later-mentioned event, in small target batches, using global plot roles and relaxed narrative-link evidence. Filter NONE before Layer 3.
event_modeling_preference: Use the shortest complete atomic lexical trigger. Remove auxiliaries, negation, arguments and surrounding noun-phrase material; preserve required phrasal particles and hyphen tokens; keep repeated spans distinct.

typing_examples.explanation: An exact event mention instance with sentence and token identity.
A directed relation instance connecting two exact event mentions.
A complete tokenized hyphenated event trigger; the incomplete span rear - is invalid.
A discourse connective alone is not an event mention.

relation_examples.text: The court order required the defendant to enter treatment.
relation_examples.explanation: The order establishes a required condition for entering treatment.

relation_examples.text: The collision was followed by an investigation.
relation_examples.explanation: The investigation is a downstream follow-up to the collision.

relation_examples.text: Hiring counsel enabled the appeal to proceed.
relation_examples.explanation: The first event enables the second.

relation_examples.text: The announcement triggered protests, followed by arrests.
relation_examples.explanation: The arrests are part of the downstream storyline after the announcement.

relation_examples.text: A resignation was announced, and the departure followed later.
relation_examples.explanation: A downstream narrative development can be a PLOT_LINK even without a direct physical causal mechanism.

relation_examples.text: The authorization allowed the inspection to begin.
relation_examples.explanation: Administrative context sets up the later event.

relation_examples.text: headline investigation announcement is directly linked to body examination begins.
relation_examples.explanation: Headline/body elaboration may be a direct narrative development.

relation_examples.text: arrest threat is directly linked to entering treatment.
relation_examples.explanation: The threat directly motivates or requires the target.

relation_examples.text: vehicle crash is directly linked to false account.
relation_examples.explanation: The text explicitly presents the account as aftermath.
In normalized storyline mention order, keep the forward narrative link rather than reversing it into cheating PRECONDITION expulsion.

relation_examples.text: The announcement was followed by details explaining the decision.
relation_examples.explanation: Later explanatory detail is a falling/downstream storyline development.

promotion_examples.explanation: Promote only when a document relation instance selected this controlled ontology property.
Event mentions remain instances rather than ontology classes.

negative_examples.text: S2[4:5]::meeting and S5[9:10]::speech occur in the same article
negative_examples.explanation: Co-occurrence alone is not a relation.
A person is not an event endpoint.
A date is not an event endpoint.
The dataset's null key is excluded from the relation vocabulary and evaluation.

negative_examples.text: S0[1:2]::announcement and S2[4:5]::rainfall are merely mentioned in the same story
negative_examples.explanation: The correct five-way decision is NONE because co-occurrence and sentence order do not establish a PLOT_LINK.

negative_examples.text: A enabled B and B caused C
negative_examples.explanation: Do not infer A-C without a direct textual link.

negative_examples.text: Two events occur in chronological order
negative_examples.explanation: Chronology alone is not a PLOT_LINK.

relation_decision_preference.direction: Hard benchmark-development prior: only earlier textual mention -> later textual mention is classified; never invert for physical causality.
relation_decision_preference.precondition: Rising action: source is setup/circumstance/condition/motivation that moves the storyline toward target.
relation_decision_preference.falling_action: Falling action: target is later continuation, consequence, aftermath, elaboration, follow-up, explanatory detail, or downstream storyline development from source.
relation_decision_preference.none: Use NONE only when there is no meaningful same-storyline PLOT_LINK. Lack of an explicit causal connective alone is not enough for NONE.
relation_decision_preference.relaxation: Narrative progression/elaboration can count even when causal directness is weak; chronology/shared topic alone still does not.
relation_decision_preference.plot_roles: Use SETUP/PIVOT/AFTERMATH as soft calibration. Correct PRECONDITION bias toward FALLING_ACTION when downstream evidence and plot roles agree.
relation_decision_preference.batching: At most 6 forward targets per source prompt.
relation_decision_preference.conflicts: Reverse-direction conflicts are eliminated by construction.
